correctness.rationale: Gauge and unitary channel averaging reduce the unrestricted finite-rank operator problem to a relaxed diagonal trace-class Dirichlet problem. An exact nonnegative difference-of-energies identity establishes its global optimum including infinite tails. The quadratic cutoff is feasible, finite rank and trace-saturating. The compact commutant of a pure shift is trivial, yielding uniqueness among all operators. All arithmetic and active-set identities are additionally tested with 263,215 exact rational assertions; finite tests do not constitute the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A finite trace budget is a natural resource for positive quasicentral approximants. The theorem gives sharp cost for every real budget and finite multiplicity, a unique optimizer even beyond diagonal matrices, an entire sequence of exact support transitions and smooth fit, and the constant \(4/9\) with comparison to a linear-taper benchmark. This is a motivated complete invariant rather than an unmotivated finite computation.
